title: Narrative text — Level 8 — Arrange and retell

items.prompt: Urutkan bagian cerita: (1) The farmer planted a magic seed. (2) Once there was a poor farmer. (3) The seed grew into a tree of gold coins.
Urutkan: (1) The deer ran to the river. (2) A deer lived in a forest. (3) One day, a fire started. (4) The deer was safe.
Ubah ke kalimat langsung: "The king said that he was tired."

visual.text: The king said, "I am tired."

choices.say: The king said, "I am tired."

visual.text: The king said, "He is tired."

choices.say: The king said, "He is tired."

visual.text: The king said, "You are tired."

choices.say: The king said, "You are tired."

visual.text: The king said, "They are tired."

choices.say: The king said, "They are tired."

items.reteach: He (raja) menjadi I dalam kalimat langsung.

items.prompt: Ubah ke kalimat tidak langsung: The girl said, "I am hungry."
